title: What Hologram Rendering Processors Is
provenance: Public research knowledge: documented developments, published research, and established technical references. Real, fact-checked records.
description: Hologram rendering processors are chips that compute true holograms in real time: they calculate light-field interference patterns fast enough to drive holographic displays at video rates, producing 3D images with real depth — no glasses, no headsets. This record is the entry point of the teaching ladder for Hologram Rendering Processors: start here, then move through the research state, the specifications, the public developments, the open challenges, and finally each piece needed to build it.
key_points: Hologram Rendering Processors in one line: Hologram rendering processors are chips that compute true holograms in real time: they calculate light-field interference patterns fast enough to drive holographic displays at video rates, producing 3D images with real depth — no glasses, no headsets.
Why it matters: True holography is the display endgame: 3D you can walk around, with focus cues your eyes expect..
Where it is used: medical visualization, design collaboration, telepresence, entertainment, museums..
Ladder rank 1 — the foundation. Everything else builds on this.

t: Current Research State of Hologram Rendering Processors
title: Current Research State of Hologram Rendering Processors

description: Computer-generated holography (CGH) algorithms accelerated on GPUs/FPGAs; neural holography learned faster synthesis; tabletop holographic displays demoed. Research focuses on real-time 4K holograms, speckle reduction, and étendue (size/brightness). The gap: compute for large, bright holograms is enormous. Research moves in three waves: laboratory proof of concept, scaled prototypes under controlled conditions, and field trials. Hologram Rendering Processors currently sits at the stage described above, and the pieces records show what each wave still needs.
